timing: assignment announcements occur in APNAP order
no priority occurs between announcements or before dealing
targets: only recipients legal for each assigning creature
choices: a player divides damage only when multiple recipients exist
forced assignments are derived without a player task
hidden_information: a later assigning player receives earlier announcements
apnap: players with assigning creatures are processed in current APNAP order
layers: effective power and creature status use derived characteristics
replacement_effects: damage replacement and prevention are separate dependencies
control_change: the current controller announces for an assigning creature
source_leaves: a departed source contributes no assignment

variants: four-player order with a player that has no assigning creature
discretionary assignments for more than one player
known_blockers: complete banding and controller-of-assignment exceptions are not implemented
the declaration UI does not yet produce every legal several-attacker blocking relationship
